variant_rationale: PORT-001 to PORT-003 used anonymised researcher-authored BEFORE descriptions, so their audits asserted organisation_identity_absent and ai_vendor_product_names_absent. PORT-004 deliberately uploads an unmodified pre-AI operational document, so those two checks are not applicable by design and are replaced by source-integrity and AI-reference checks.

ai_term_scan.scope: all 58 pages of the source PDF plus OCR of both full-page graphics (900-39, 900-44); and the frozen 20-page product input
ai_term_scan.method: case-insensitive regex over pdftotext output and tesseract OCR output
ai_term_scan.automated_disposition: All 16 inspected. Every occurrence is either a proper product name (Examiner's Automated Search Tool / EAST, Web-based Examiner Search Tool / WEST, Foreign Patent Access System / FPAS) or a generic reference to electronic full-text and Boolean retrieval. No occurrence implies inference, ranking or model-based retrieval.

ai_separation_timeline.margin_to_earliest_ai_event: 2 years 2 months from publication to the AI-for-PE2E notice
ai_separation_timeline.margin_to_implementation: 2 years 3 months from publication to SimSearch entering examiner use
ai_separation_timeline.next_mpep_revision_excluded: E9R-07.2022, published February 2023, is post-implementation and was rejected as a BEFORE source

residual_risk_basis: The BEFORE document is an operational manual authored by the examining authority for examiner guidance, published years before the AI implementation, with its date independently corroborated by a Federal Register notice and by the PDF's own embedded creation timestamp. No AI-assisted search reference appears anywhere in the source. No researcher paraphrase or inference enters the product input.
